_comment: Transcribed from an in-game screenshot taken 2026-08-01 (Steam capture index 122 in the 16:03 run). Gadget screens carry a name, a model designation and a description but no stat block or trait chips, so this item has no stats or ratings. Art is cropped from the same shot. The page leads with the model designation because that is what EA's patch notes use.
name: Recon Drone

description.text: A combat drone armed with an electronics disruption weapon, able to target gadgets through walls and destroy them without line of sight. Can be left hovering to automatically spot hostiles, marking their position in-world and on the minimap. Equipped with thermal vision for enhanced spotting.

_unlock_note: Unlock recorded 2026-08-02 from Battlefield 6's own in-game unlock and challenge data. Not from the screenshot cited above: unlock text only displays in-game on items the account does not own.
